CustomField.description: An unpaid booking or staff top-up has an accepted manual payment request.
CustomField.formula: AND(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c, NOT(NTE_Finance_Requirements_Due__c), OR(AND(OR(NTE_Invoice_Required__c = "Yes", NTE_Listed_Price_Total__c > 0, NOT(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(NTE_Approval_Email_Sent_At__c)), NOT(NTE_Payment_Received__c)), AND(OR(NTE_Top_Up_Invoice_Required__c, BLANKVALUE(NTE_Top_Up_Staff_Total__c, 0) > 0), NOT(ISBLANK(NTE_Top_Up_Payment_Requested_At__c)), NOT(NTE_Top_Up_Payment_Received__c))))
CustomField.label: NTE Payment Required
